Man in police custody for alleged murder of a 2-year-old in Hohoe
26-year-old Robert Akator has been apprehended by the Volta North Regional Police Command for the alleged murder of a two-year-old boy at Wli-Afegame, in the Hohoe Municipality.
He was apprehended on 15th September 2026, after Police discovered the lifeless body of the deceased, following an intelligence tip-off.
A communique signed by the Volta North Regional Public Relations Officer, Inspr. Felix Kwao, indicated that the corpse has since been deposited at the morgue for preservation and autopsy.
He added that the suspect is in “police custody assisting with the investigation into the circumstances surrounding the incident.
“He will be put before the court to face justice”, he stressed.
